Design a Java program using the following class hierarchy:
          Notification

            /      \

Create EmailNotification and SMSNotification classes that inherit from Notification and provide their own implementations of the cost calculation.

Cost = Message Length × 0.10

The input consists of three lines:
1. Notification type (Email or SMS)
2. Recipient name
3. Message length
Constraints
- Notification type must be Email or SMS.
- Recipient name must be non-empty and must not contain numeric characters.
- Message length must be a positive integer.
- Numeric input must be valid.
Output Format

Notification sent to: <recipient>
Total Cost: <totalCost>
